newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine sets budget deficit for 1998 at 5 pct GDP.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine sets budget deficit for 1998 at 5 pct GDP.

text.p: Ukraine's parliament set next year's budget deficit at five percent of gross domestic product, from 5.7 percent for this year's deficit or four percent by Western calculations.
Deputies voted 247 to 18 for a resolution on next year's budget which said it would focus on "improving domestic production".
The 1998 draft was given preliminary approval on June 11, when a member of the budget committee said GDP was forecast at about 110 billion hryvnias from 100 billion hryvnias this year.
Deputies banned state authorities from acquiring imports with state funds if local equivalents were available.
